coverage: Whole company · one reported business segment
definition: Net profit for the company after materials, staff, other costs, the unusual charges and tax. The company does not report separate profit for bearing rings and vehicle parts.
location: PDF page 131, standalone profit and loss. PDF pages 166 and 173–174, notes 32 and 37.
notes: Unusual charges of ₹51.64 crore included an additional cost for settling an old claim from lenders and an increase in employee benefit obligations under new labour rules. The final ₹101 crore payment to lenders also settled amounts charged in earlier years.
insight: Sales were slightly lower and reported profit fell compared with the previous year. Profit before unusual charges and tax was higher. The accounts also identify a small group of large buyers, so changes in their orders matter.
